description: GTFS-Hub is a data resource listed in awesome-transit (MobilityData), a community list of transit data, APIs and tools under the section "3rd party GTFS URL directories > Crowdsourced transit data", published or maintained by as named on github.com. Community tested, probably quality/content enhanced, partially merged or filtered GTFS-feeds of (currently German) transport agencies. Maintained by MITFAHRDEZENTRALE. Coverage: Germany. The list files it under "3rd party GTFS URL directories > Crowdsourced transit data". The entry links to github.com. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-transit-community-list.
